title: Pop Culture 2020s
description: Test your knowledge of popular culture from the 2020s

questions.question: Which film won the Academy Award for Best Picture in 2020?
choices: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
questions.explanation: Parasite, the South Korean film directed by Bong Joon-ho, won Best Picture at the 2020 Academy Awards, becoming the first non-English language film to win the award.

questions.question: What popular video conferencing app became widely used during the COVID-19 pandemic?
questions.explanation: Zoom became the most popular video conferencing platform during the 2020 pandemic, with its daily users jumping from 10 million to over 300 million.

questions.question: Which streaming service launched in 2019 featuring Disney content?
questions.explanation: Disney+ launched in November 2019, quickly becoming one of the major streaming platforms with Marvel, Star Wars, and classic Disney content.

questions.question: What social media platform did Elon Musk acquire in 2022?
questions.explanation: Elon Musk acquired Twitter in October 2022 for approximately $44 billion and later rebranded it as X.

questions.question: Which Taylor Swift album was released in 2020 during the pandemic?
questions.explanation: Taylor Swift surprise-released Folklore in July 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic, marking a shift to indie folk and alternative rock sound.

questions.question: What is the name of the AI chatbot released by OpenAI in 2022?
questions.explanation: ChatGPT was released by OpenAI in November 2022 and quickly became one of the most popular AI applications in history.

questions.question: Which streaming series broke Netflix viewership records in 2021?
questions.explanation: Squid Game, a South Korean survival drama, became Netflix's most-watched series in 2021, with over 1.65 billion viewing hours in its first 28 days.

questions.question: What was the most-streamed song globally on Spotify in 2023?
choices: As It Was by Harry Styles
questions.explanation: Flowers by Miley Cyrus was the most-streamed song globally on Spotify in 2023, accumulating over 1.6 billion streams.
